questions.question: Which writer was named winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: The Canadian poet Anne Carson won, with the prize citing how her work reimagines classical literature in new forms.
questions.context: 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature: Canadian poet Anne Carson is awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for "her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature".

questions.question: The Bank of England says its next banknotes will replace historical figures with what?
questions.explanation: The new notes will show animals such as the Atlantic puffin and European hedgehog, the first time wildlife has replaced people on English notes.
questions.context: The Bank of England announces that the Atlantic puffin, barn owl, buff-tailed bumblebee, and European hedgehog will feature on the next set of pound sterling notes to be issued in the United Kingdom. It will be the first time animals have replaced people on banknotes in England, which is intended to increase awareness of British wildlife.

questions.question: Which demand did Taiwan credit for its record export figures for September?
questions.explanation: Taiwan reported record exports, imports and trade surplus, pointing to demand for artificial intelligence hardware.
questions.context: AI boom, Semiconductor industry in Taiwan: Taiwan's finance ministry reports that exports reached a record US$87.2 billion in September, while imports rose to a record $63.6 billion and the trade surplus reached a record $23.6 billion, citing demand for artificial intelligence-related hardware.

questions.question: Why did South Korea recall its ambassador to Ukraine?
options: A dispute over arms export licences
Ukraine's vote at the United Nations
Comments by Ukraine's president about Seoul
Ukraine revealed a confidential prisoner transfer
questions.explanation: Seoul accused Kyiv of breaking a non-disclosure agreement by making public the handover of two captured North Korean soldiers.
questions.context: South Korea–Ukraine relations, North Korean involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war: South Korea recalls its ambassador to Ukraine after accusing Ukraine of breaching a non-disclosure agreement by disclosing the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea.

questions.question: In Japanese baseball, what did the Hanshin Tigers player Teruaki Satō win?
options: The Rookie of the Year award
questions.explanation: Satō took the Nippon Professional Baseball Triple Crown, the first player to do so since Munetaka Murakami in 2022.
questions.context: 2026 Nippon Professional Baseball season: In baseball, Teruaki Satō of the Hanshin Tigers wins the Triple Crown; the last NPB Triple Crown was won by Munetaka Murakami in 2022.
